parameters.name: vault_conn_id
parameters.description: The id of the connection to use

parameters.name: auth_type
parameters.description: Authentication Type for the Vault. Default is ``token``. Available values are: ('approle', 'aws_iam', 'azure', 'github', 'gcp', 'jwt', 'kubernetes', 'ldap', 'radius', 'token', 'userpass')

parameters.name: auth_mount_point
parameters.description: It can be used to define mount_point for authentication chosen Default depends on the authentication method used.

parameters.name: kv_engine_version
parameters.description: Select the version of the engine to run (``1`` or ``2``). Defaults to version defined in connection or ``2`` if not defined in connection.

parameters.name: role_id
parameters.description: Role ID for ``approle``, ``aws_iam`` and ``gcp`` Authentication.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: AWS region for STS API calls (for ``aws_iam`` auth_type).

parameters.name: kubernetes_role
parameters.description: Role for Authentication (for ``kubernetes`` auth_type)

parameters.name: kubernetes_jwt_path
parameters.description: Path for kubernetes jwt token (for ``kubernetes`` auth_type, default: ``/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token``)

parameters.name: token_path
parameters.description: path to file containing authentication token to include in requests sent to Vault (for ``token`` and ``github`` auth_type).

parameters.name: gcp_key_path
parameters.description: Path to Google Cloud Service Account key file (JSON) (for ``gcp`` auth_type) Mutually exclusive with gcp_keyfile_dict

parameters.name: gcp_scopes
parameters.description: Comma-separated string containing OAuth2 scopes (for ``gcp`` auth_type)

parameters.name: azure_tenant_id
parameters.description: The tenant id for the Azure Active Directory (for ``azure`` auth_type)

parameters.name: azure_resource
parameters.description: The configured URL for the application registered in Azure Active Directory (for ``azure`` auth_type)

parameters.name: radius_host
parameters.description: Host for radius (for ``radius`` auth_type)

parameters.name: radius_port
parameters.description: Port for radius (for ``radius`` auth_type)

parameters.name: jwt_role
parameters.description: Role for Authentication (for ``jwt`` auth_type)

parameters.name: jwt_token
parameters.description: JWT token for Authentication (for ``jwt`` auth_type)

parameters.name: jwt_token_path
parameters.description: Path to file containing JWT token for Authentication (for ``jwt`` auth_type).

parameters.name: connections_path
parameters.description: Specifies the path of the secret to read to get Connections. (default: 'connections'). If set to None (null), requests for connections will not be sent to Vault.

parameters.name: variables_path
parameters.description: Specifies the path of the secret to read to get Variable. (default: 'variables'). If set to None (null), requests for variables will not be sent to Vault.

parameters.name: config_path
parameters.description: Specifies the path of the secret to read Airflow Configurations (default: 'config'). If set to None (null), requests for configurations will not be sent to Vault.

parameters.name: use_team_secrets_path
parameters.description: Flag to enable team scoped secret retrieval from {base_path}/{team_name}/{key} in multi team deployments. (default: true)

parameters.name: global_secrets_path
parameters.description: Path prefix to add to global scoped connections and variables in multi team deployments. (default: No prefix)

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Base URL for the Vault instance being addressed.

parameters.name: auth_type
parameters.description: Authentication Type for Vault. Default is ``token``. Available values are: ('approle', 'aws_iam', 'azure', 'github', 'gcp', 'jwt', 'kubernetes', 'ldap', 'radius', 'token', 'userpass')

parameters.name: auth_mount_point
parameters.description: It can be used to define mount_point for authentication chosen Default depends on the authentication method used.

parameters.name: mount_point
parameters.description: The "path" the secret engine was mounted on. Default is "secret". Note that this mount_point is not used for authentication if authentication is done via a different engine. If set to None, the mount secret should be provided as a prefix for each variable/connection_id. For authentication mount_points see, auth_mount_point.

parameters.name: kv_engine_version
parameters.description: Select the version of the engine to run (``1`` or ``2``, default: ``2``).

parameters.description: Authentication token to include in requests sent to Vault. (for ``token`` and ``github`` auth_type)
